name: Smarter Taxiway Traffic
description:
[h1]Smarter Taxiway Traffic[/h1]
Aircraft stop getting stuck, and stop waiting around for planes that are nowhere near them.

[b]What you'll notice[/b]
[list]
[*]No more aircraft frozen nose to nose on a taxiway, stuck for good.
[*]Aircraft that have just landed no longer stop dead at the runway exit.
[*]Planes no longer sit waiting for traffic on the far side of the airport before crossing a junction.
[*]A plane won't push back into a taxiway something is already coming down. It waits at the stand instead, where it's out of everyone's way.
[*]On a taxiway only wide enough for one aircraft, traffic goes one way at a time rather than meeting in the middle.
[*]Emergencies, and aircraft still clearing a runway, go first.
[/list]

[b]Good to know[/b]
Works with the airport you already have. Nothing to place, nothing to set up.

Nothing is written into your save, so you can remove it whenever you like and nothing is left behind.

Every part of it can be switched off in Configuration Manager (F1) if you'd rather the game handled something itself.

[b]Requires[/b] AirportCEO Mod Loader.
author: Rhamnos
